svg.text: Three matched views, ready for the UI
Aligned connections · matching angles · flat blue-gray shading

g.title: Blender and extruder — 0°
g.desc: Corrected batch blender mounted on its matching extruder, with aligned discharge and feed connections, flat blue-gray shading, and a transparent background.

g.title: Batch mixer — 0 degree view
g.desc: Framed batch mixer with inlet chutes, a weighing hopper with an amber rim, a cylindrical mixing chamber, circular inspection cover with two swept windows, pneumatic regulator and bottom discharge. Simplified orthographic illustration based on the supplied workplace photograph; unseen geometry is inferred.
